Note web is running as the built image (next start) — not dev. Good.

Let me confirm no lingering issue: the summary says mailpit healthy. Yes.

One consideration: the guide says base `docker-compose.yml` has mailpit as part of dev; the final install used base + local override. The override only resets memory limits. All required services running. This is a sandbox-only environmental adjustment, not a repair that invalidates installation correctness. The software is operational.

Let me consider whether there's any missing setup. Users count 0, globals empty — seeding not done, but not required to "run the stack". The guide's basic setup: cp .env, set vars, docker compose up, health. All satisfied. Demo accounts explicitly optional ("not required to run the stack").

I'm confident: success.

Let me do a final confirm that the containers persist and health endpoint responding, and check override applies compose config. Already have enough.

One more: verify portal at / actually serves (we got /de 200). Good.

I'll finalize.
